## Objective

One concrete behavior and its user benefit.

## Phase and dependencies

Phase / blocking issue IDs. Split independent deliverables.

## Read

AGENTS.md + docs/INDEX.md, then 1–3 exact relevant paths. Do not paste the full spec.

## Implement

Affected paths/services; migrations and API/AI contract changes if applicable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable happy-path outcome
- [ ] Relevant error/retry/permission behavior
- [ ] Applicable verification passes

## Out of scope

Explicit boundaries.

## Verification

Exact commands and/or browser journey, fixture, expected result. Do not invent script names.

## Handoff

Changed paths, checks, unresolved blockers; update canonical docs only if behavior changed.
